name: Be Our Guest Restaurant

attributes.typical_price_notes: Prix-fixe, 3-course lunch/dinner menu; roughly $72/adult and $43/child (ages 3-9) as of this research pass.
attributes.dietary_accommodation_notes: Plant-based menu items available (made without animal meat, dairy, eggs, or honey); guests with allergies can ask to speak with a Special Diets Trained Cast Member on arrival.

sources.title: Be Our Guest Restaurant | Walt Disney World Resort
